title: Pullback compatibility of universally free lowest cohomology
statement: Let $S$ and $T$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $E$ a perfect complex in the derived category of $S$ [def-pc-perfect-complex, def-pc-derived-category] of Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes], $r\in\mathbf N$, and $h:T\to S$. Assume that for every $v:T\prime\to T$, $H^a(L(h\circ v)^*E)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Then for every $g:T\prime\to T$ there exists an isomorphism $g^*H^a(Lh^*E)\cong H^a(L(h\circ g)^*E)$ of module sheaves [def-pc-module-pullback]. This asserts a cohomology comparison only and constructs no immersion or representing scheme.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma locally-closed-where-H0-locally-free, Tag 0BDL, pullback comparison clause and the zero outgoing differential in the matrix-chart proof

proof.text: Apply the local zero-bottom-differential model theorem to S,E,a,b,r,T,h and universal freeness. This gives the stated model condition for D=Lh*E at every point of T.
Apply the model-based bottom-cohomology pullback theorem to D=Lh*E and g. This gives an isomorphism g*H^a(Lh*E) ≅ H^a(Lg*Lh*E).

Obtain the composition isomorphism c(g,h) from the existing derived pullback composition theorem, evaluate it at E, and map it through the degree-a homology functor. Compose this isomorphism with the preceding one to obtain the unchanged conclusion.

proof_origin.place: W2 decomposition of the existing matrix-chart plan into local structural models and their homological comparison, followed by the actual Lean composition isomorphism.

theorem perfectUniversalLowestCohomology_pullback
    [∀ T : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))]
    (S : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ U : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory S) (hE : IsPerfect S E) (a b : ℤ)
    (hamp : ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace),
      ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes S E F i)
    (r : ℕ)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ S)
    (hfree :
      ∀ (T' : Scheme.{u}) (u' : T' ⟶ T),
        SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) a).obj
              ((derivedPullback (u' ≫ h)).obj E)) r)
    (T' : Scheme.{u}) (g : T' ⟶ T) :
    Nonempty
      ((Modules.tensorPullback g).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) a).obj
              ((derivedPullback h).obj E)) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) a).obj
            ((derivedPullback (g ≫ h)).obj E))
